cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've taken charge of your wedding dress, and of looking after you. It reached our depot this morning. Please take this chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: May I have the address? I'll collect it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me approve the easiest course for you. It's one of our depots; you needn't tire yourself with a journey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you at least give me their number?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're entitled to my undivided attention. Stay here with me, dear. I've authorized as much time for you as you need.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 takes charge of dress and customer, A3 approves only a vague course, and A5 grants time and attention instead of contact access.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 collection proposal gets A3 vague depot and discouragement; B4 number request gets A5 personal availability only.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 offer increasingly modest ways to solve the customer's problem independently.

heightening.evidence: A5 supplies no logistical fact after B4 asks for the minimum contact detail, while increasing reassurance.

specificity.evidence: A1 wedding dress and morning arrival establish a clear customer-service need.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 unlimited attention instead of a number is a pointed contrast, though the dear can sound patronizing.
